description: This file defines the EditNoteActivity class, which provides an Android activity allowing users to create or edit notes with a UI consisting of input fields and menu options. It interacts with a NoteRepository for data persistence and manages UI components for editing note contents.

classes.name: EditNoteActivity
classes.description: A Kotlin class representing an Android activity for editing or creating notes, managing UI components and persisting data through NoteRepository.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and retrieves existing note data if editing.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with save functionality.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as saving or navigating back.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input and saves the note data via NoteRepository.
